top_signals.title: Asian Stocks Poised to Gain, Crude Holds Decline: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Asian stocks were set to extend gains Friday as further evidence of moderating US inflation and a pullback in oil prices reinforced bets that the Federal Reserve will refrain from raising interest rates next month.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
